name: class_decorator_detection_in_class_field_a1dfb1ab
subject: Fix class decorator detection in class fields transform (#58554)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Class decorator detection in the class fields transform only checked ClassDeclaration, and getClassThis used Debug.checkDefined, which caused a crash (esDecoratorsClassFieldsCrash) and wrong emit for class expressions; fixed by using isClassLike and a tolerant lookup.
